facts.title: Favorite Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 pound broccoli florets (from 1 ½ pounds broccoli stalks), thinly sliced and then roughly chopped (see photos)
½ cup raw sunflower seeds or slivered almonds
½ cup finely chopped red onion
½ cup grated sharp cheddar cheese (optional)
⅓ cup dried cranberries or dried tart cherries, chopped
1 medium clove garlic, pressed or minced
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
